deskyard double-click: double left-click at X Y

Usage: deskyard [-e NAME] double-click X Y

Double-clicks the left button at X Y (selects a word, opens a file).

Arguments:
  X          integer     required  horizontal pixel position, 0 = left edge
  Y          integer     required  vertical pixel position, 0 = top edge

Prints: nothing

Examples:
  deskyard double-click 200 300

Where: inside an environment it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen environment (-e NAME)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the desktop
